businesses.business: building materials and building envelope solutions

offering_description.value: Makes and sells cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete and asphalt, plus building envelope products such as roofing systems and wall and insulation products. Customers are contractors, builders, distributors and infrastructure owners in North America. It produces these from its own quarries, cement plants and factories.

primary_products.value: cement; aggregates; ready-mix concrete; asphalt; commercial and residential roofing systems

primary_services.value: paving and construction contracting; roofing technical support services

customer_segment.value: B2B: contractors, builders, roofing contractors, distributors, commercial and residential developers; B2G: federal, state and local infrastructure agencies buying paving and construction materials

end_markets.value: infrastructure; commercial construction; residential construction; roofing and re-roofing

revenue_model.value: product sales: cement, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, roofing and envelope products sold by volume; project or contract: paving and construction contracts, some for public infrastructure

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: quarries raw materials and makes cement, concrete and roofing products, sold to contractors and distributors; raw materials: supplies aggregates and cement used in concrete and construction

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: building materials (cement, aggregates, concrete) and building envelope (roofing, walls, insulation)

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: to contractors, builders and infrastructure project owners; distributors / dealers: roofing and building products distributors; own locations: company-owned ready-mix and aggregates sites and distribution branches
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, emissions, quarry permitting and workplace safety rules (EPA, MSHA, OSHA)

notes: Amrize was spun off from Holcim in 2025 as its North American business. Service and channel details are less certain.
